title: Dating App Privacy Policy Template - Complete Guide
metaDescription: Comprehensive privacy policy template for dating apps. Covers data collection, user safety, location tracking, and GDPR compliance requirements.
description: A complete privacy policy template specifically designed for dating applications. Covers essential privacy protections including location data, personal information handling, photo sharing policies, matching algorithms, and user safety measures.

sections.heading: Information We Collect
sections.content:
We collect the following types of information to provide our dating services:

**Profile Information:** Name, age, gender, sexual orientation, photos, bio, interests, and preferences you provide during registration.

**Location Data:** We collect precise location information when you enable location services to show you nearby matches. You can disable location sharing in your device settings.

**Usage Data:** How you interact with profiles, messages sent/received, time spent on the app, and features used.

**Device Information:** Device type, operating system, IP address, browser type, and unique device identifiers.

**Photos and Content:** Images and any content you upload to your profile or share in messages.

**Verification Data:** Information used to verify your identity, including government-issued ID when using verification features.

sections.heading: How We Use Your Information
sections.content:
Your information is used to:

• **Matching Services:** Create your profile and show you to potential matches based on preferences, location, and compatibility
• **Communication:** Enable messaging between matched users
• **Safety & Security:** Detect fake profiles, prevent harassment, and maintain community standards
• **App Improvement:** Analyze usage patterns to improve matching algorithms and user experience
• **Customer Support:** Respond to inquiries and provide assistance
• **Legal Compliance:** Comply with applicable laws and respond to legal requests

**We do not sell your personal information to third parties.** Your dating profile and personal messages remain private between you and your matches.

sections.heading: Information Sharing and Disclosure
sections.content:
We may share your information in these limited circumstances:

**With Other Users:** Your profile information and photos are visible to other users based on your privacy settings and matching preferences.

**Service Providers:** Trusted third-party companies that help us operate the app (hosting, analytics, customer support) under strict confidentiality agreements.

**Safety & Legal:** When required by law, to protect user safety, prevent fraud, or respond to legal processes.

**Business Transfers:** In the event of a merger, acquisition, or sale of assets, user information may be transferred with appropriate notice.

**With Your Consent:** Any other sharing will require your explicit consent.

**We never share your private messages or exact location** with other users or third parties except as required by law.

sections.heading: Privacy Controls and Settings
sections.content:
You have control over your privacy:

**Profile Visibility:** Control who can see your profile, photos, and last active status
**Location Privacy:** Choose to hide your distance or disable location sharing entirely
**Photo Privacy:** Select which photos are public vs. private
**Incognito Mode:** Browse profiles privately without appearing in their visitor list (premium feature)
**Block and Report:** Block users and report inappropriate behavior
**Message Controls:** Control who can message you first

**Privacy Tips:**
• Use Incognito Browser when accessing dating apps on shared devices
• Review your profile regularly to ensure information is current
• Be selective about personal information shared in messages
• Report suspicious profiles or behavior immediately

sections.heading: Data Retention and Deletion
sections.content:
**Account Active:** We retain your information as long as your account is active to provide our services.

**Account Deletion:** When you delete your account:
• Profile information is removed within 30 days
• Messages may be retained for safety and legal compliance
• Some data may be kept longer for legal or safety purposes
• Cached data may remain temporarily in our systems

**Data Download:** You can request a copy of your data before deletion through your account settings.

**Automatic Cleanup:** Inactive accounts may be automatically deleted after [TIME_PERIOD] of inactivity with advance notice.

sections.heading: Security Measures
sections.content:
We implement strong security measures to protect your information:

• **Encryption:** All data transmission is encrypted using industry-standard SSL/TLS
• **Secure Storage:** Personal information is stored on secure servers with restricted access
• **Photo Protection:** Images are processed to remove metadata and stored securely
• **Account Security:** Two-factor authentication available for additional protection
• **Regular Audits:** Security practices are regularly reviewed and updated
• **Staff Training:** Employees receive privacy and security training

**Your Security:**
• Use strong, unique passwords for your account
• Enable two-factor authentication when available
• Never share login credentials with others
• Use Incognito Browser on shared or public devices
• Report security concerns immediately

sections.heading: International Users and Data Transfers
sections.content:
**Global Service:** Our dating service operates internationally, and your information may be transferred to and processed in countries other than your residence.

**GDPR Compliance:** For users in the European Union, we comply with GDPR requirements including:
• Lawful basis for processing personal data
• Right to access, rectify, or delete your data
• Right to data portability
• Right to object to processing
• Data protection impact assessments

**Legal Basis:** We process your data based on:
• Contract performance (providing dating services)
• Legitimate interests (safety, fraud prevention)
• Consent (marketing communications)
• Legal obligations (compliance with applicable laws)

**Data Protection Officer:** Contact our DPO at [DPO_EMAIL] for privacy-related inquiries.

sections.heading: Contact Information
sections.content:
For privacy-related questions or concerns:

**Email:** [PRIVACY_EMAIL]
**Mail:** [COMPANY_ADDRESS]
**Privacy Portal:** [PRIVACY_URL]

We will respond to privacy inquiries within [RESPONSE_TIME] business days.

This privacy policy was last updated on [LAST_UPDATED] and is effective immediately.
